meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成代码改动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要向团队解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Generate explainer videos from code changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to your team

howto.what: 把 GitHub 上的一个 PR（代码改动）变成讲解视频。它会读取该 PR 的 diff、提交和文件，规划故事板和旁白，逐帧生成画面，最终输出 mp4 视频。
howto.when: 当用户给出一个 PR 链接、owner/repo 加编号，或在已检出仓库里说“这个 PR”，并要求把它做成视频时触发。若主题不是 PR 或意图不明确，会先转向 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把当前仓库里这个 PR 变成一个代码改动说明视频
say.note: 需要当前目录是已检出的仓库。

say.text: 为 owner/repo#42 做一个修复类 PR 的讲解视频
say.note: 会按 PR 类型规划叙事。

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request into an explainer video: it reads the PR's diff, commits, and files, plans a storyboard and narration, builds frames one by one, and renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a PR URL, an owner/repo#N reference, or says 'this PR' in a checked-out repo, and asks for a video. Non-PR topics or unclear intents go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this PR https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123 into an explainer video
say_en.note: It reads the PR diff and generates a video.

say_en.text: Make a code-change explainer video for this PR in the current repo
Create a fix-explainer video for owner/repo#42
say_en.note: Narration is shaped to the PR type.
